ModMetaData.name: EPrime's Quality Jobs
ModMetaData.author: Morten Mertner
ModMetaData.description:
Quality Jobs lets everyone work on unfinished items, but only qualified colonists are allowed to finish the job. Works for both crafting and construction.
You can configure default quality options and override these per bill or buildable.
For crafting, sharing of unfinished works also unblocks bills so they don't become locked to the colonist last working on an item.
Multiplayer compatible. Safe to add/remove mid-save (but when removing you must use the settings option to disable the mod, otherwise unfinished bill items will have to be dismantled). Designed for performance: cached rendering, no per-frame work, event- and interval-driven logic. Requires Harmony.
